# A source caller of the ejected helpers keeps one name in both builds:
# RequireExtendedConnect and RequireExtendedConnectFunc exist natively
# too. Natively they enable the per-server opt-in; ejected they require
# the process-startup GODEBUG setting and fail fast without it.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd helper
logos run .
stdout '^helper ready$'
logos eject -o out
grep 'RequireExtendedConnect' out/main.go
! grep 'EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
env GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1
go run .
stdout '^helper ready$'
env GODEBUG=
! exec go run .
stderr 'needs GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1'
stderr 'on server "srv"'
env GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1
exec go run .
stdout '^helper ready$'
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

-- helper/go.mod --
module example.com/h2require

go 1.27

-- helper/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	logohttp "logos/net/http"
)

func main() {
	srv := &http.Server{Addr: "127.0.0.1:0"}
	logohttp.RequireExtendedConnect("srv", srv)
	f := logohttp.RequireExtendedConnectFunc("srv", srv)
	f()
	fmt.Println("helper ready")
}
